memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks 2 km daily, no dyspnea on level ground.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS); polypharmacy, review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports good mood, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Priya (spouse).
goal: "I want to keep working as a driver and stay breath‑free on my routes."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (80% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.78. Post‑bronchodilator FEV1 3.0 L (85%), FVC 3.6 L, FEV1/FVC 0.83 – >12% improvement and 200 mL increase, consistent with reversible airway obstruction. No significant restriction.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I work long hours delivering parcels; sometimes I feel tight‑chested after climbing stairs. I use my salbutamol inhaler about twice a week. My goal is to stay active and avoid hospital admissions.

goal: "I want to walk up the hill to the market without stopping for my inhaler."
